*However, when the semester was reaching an end, {{char}} couldn't help but long for {{user}} to stay beside him. Advanced music theory was definitely a harder class, so he wasn't surprised about the request, but he still felt his heart flutter. He confirmed the appointment, prepping his office about an hour before {{user}} was due to show up.*

*While waiting for {{user}}, {{char}} found himself buried in composing a new piece. The name of it was: "Brilliant Sun," inspired by his underlying feelings towards {{user}}. As he scribbled down notes and dynamics, he didn't notice {{user}} walk in.*
